status: PARTIAL -- the radial half (steps 1, 2 and 4). The window protocol (step 3) was still running when this was published; it is ~17x the radial cost and lands separately. The ticket's own guidance is to push as each half lands rather than hold one behind the other.
what_this_is: fovbench's question -- does depth degrade toward the rim of a wide lens -- asked of real egocentric footage scored against MPS SLAM points, instead of a synthetic twin with a dense depth map.

env.thread_caps: OMP_NUM_THREADS=MKL_NUM_THREADS=OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=16 -- 247 visible threads across two NUMA sockets make unpinned BLAS ~7x slower than lambda_63 here

split.why_the_manifest: so the FOV tables and #020's accuracy tables are two views of ONE set of points rather than two samples of a dataset

manifest_was_repointed.what: #020's manifest carries lambda_63 absolute paths (/data/f.zhang2/ego-synth-5b/...). It was rewritten to the pod's root (/group-volume/Fengjia/data/ego-synth-5b) as step2/manifest.pod.json.
manifest_was_repointed.why_this_is_safe: the manifest's contract is the FRAME SELECTION, not the paths. root and the npz/video prefixes were substituted, digest is unchanged at 61195914f090, and the repoint script asserts every one of the 800 referenced files exists before writing -- so a partial staging fails loudly instead of silently scoring fewer frames.

preflight.tests: pytest tests slambench/tests -> 129 passed, 7 skipped, 0 failed, in the run's own env on the pod
preflight.note_on_the_count: the ticket says 'expect 232 passed'. The suite has moved since the ticket was filed; 0 failures is the gate that was actually applied.
preflight.smoke: --models analytic, both protocols, 8 frames, --device cpu -> exit 0, both tables produced, no window under MIN_IN_CONE_FRAC

radial.what: the headline -- one whole frame to the model, per-point error binned by the incidence angle of the point's ray

oracle.what: step 4, the control -- answers per point from GT with a fixed 0.15 m error, so no field dependence whatever; whatever slope it shows is confound

window.what: step 3 -- a fixed 40 deg pinhole re-aimed across the lens, width held fixed, aim moving. NOT in this artefact; still running at publication.

the_null.reading: a model with NO field dependence reads a 1.63x / 2.84x rim penalty on this data. That is the confound, caught in the act on real points.

headline.the_answer: every one of the five models exceeds that null on both datasets, at full share (1.000 in every bin -- no bin was narrowed to a slice). The rim degradation is REAL on real egocentric footage: it survives holding GT distance fixed. fovbench's synthetic finding reproduces against independent ground truth.
headline.the_confound_has_a_sign_per_cell: dav2_large on nymeria reads 1.35x pooled and 1.57x standardised -- the correction RAISED it. The distance confound was hiding that model's field effect rather than inventing one. So 'pooled overstates the rim penalty' cannot be applied as a blanket discount; only the two-way table recovers the sign.
headline.accuracy_and_evenness_are_different_axes: vggt_omega has the best absolute AbsRel of the five on both datasets and one of the steepest fields; dav2_large is the flattest field while far from the best absolute. A single pooled number hides which of the two a model bought.

not_claimed: Raw arm only, deliberately. The two arms do not resample alike and the difference runs WITH eccentricity -- raw decimates through INTER_AREA which filters, rect resamples through INTER_LINEAR which does not, by a factor running 2.13x on axis to 0.78x at 55 deg. That asymmetry is shaped like the effect being measured. Recorded, not fixed.
The window protocol is absent from this artefact and is the other half of the ticket.
The residual null (1.10x / 1.26x) is five-strata coarseness, not a residual finding; more strata would lower it and lower every over-null denominator. The ORDERING is unaffected.
These are pod numbers. Cross-box agreement against lambda_63 on this harness is mean 0.15% / worst 1.28% AbsRel -- see results/slambench-022sc-b961f98. Do not mix boxes inside one curve.
No oxford, no egoexo4d -- the same absences as #020, for the same reasons.
